cs.t: I've got a roborock s6 from 2019 and it's still going very well. I I've had it dismantled a few times, once when the cat pissed on it, once to clean the vacuum motor, and most recently when one of the wheels got clogged. It's really easy to replace individual parts, this is how consumer electronics should be. Unfortunately I've read the later models are harder to repair, and I would like to upgrade for the better mopping and self emptying.
cs.th: iRobot made Roomba into an icon. Now, it's in a mess

cs.t: Robot Vacuum (Roborock S6): I always thought they were some gimmick. No. Should have bought one much earlier. M1 MBA: I ditched Apple hardware a year ago after their pretty crappy macbook pro lines. This thing is great and the hype is real. OneWheel: Always wanted to try. It is extremely fun but I’m too old to recover broken bones fast so I got rid of it.
